```{r}
library(PNADcIBGE)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- PNADcIBGE::read_pnadc(
  microdata = "c:/microdados/trimestre4/PNADC_2024_trimestre4.txt",
  input_txt = "c:/microdados/trimestre4/input_PNADC_trimestre4_20251010.txt",
  vars  = c(
      "VDI5008", "VDI5009", "V1022",
      "V2001", "V2005",   "V2007",   "V2010",
      "V2009", "V40132A", "SD17001",
      "VD3004", "VD4007",
      "VD4016",  "VD4018",  "VD4019",  "VD4020", "VDI4022",
      "VI5001A2", "VI5002A", "VI5002A2",
      "VI5003A2", "VI5004A2", "VI5005A2",
      "VI5006A2", "VI5007A2", "VI5008A2"
    )
)
```

```{r}
data <- raw_data |> 
  # =========================
  # FILTRO INICIAL
  # =========================
  
  dplyr::filter(UF == 23) |> 

  # =========================
  # LIMPEZA E VARIÁVEIS BÁSICAS
  # =========================
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    # Raça
    raca = dplyr::case_when(
      V2010 %in% c(2, 4) ~ "Preta ou Parda",
      V2010 == 1 ~ "Branca",
      TRUE ~ "Outra"
    ),
    
    # Estrato simplificado
    Estrato = stringr::str_sub(Estrato, 1, 4),
    
    Estrato = forcats::fct_recode(Estrato, 
                                  "Fortaleza" = "2310",
                                  "RMF"       = "2320",
                                  "Litoral Ocidental e Norte do Ceará"= "2353",
                                  "Litoral Oriental Vale do R. Jaguaribe"="2354",
                                  "Sertões do Ceará"="2352",
                                  "Sul do Ceará"="2351"
    ),
    
    # Dummy geográfica
    regiao_metro = dplyr::if_else(Estrato %in% c("Fortaleza", "RMF"), "RMF", "Interior"),
    
    faixa_renda = dplyr::case_when(
      # VDI5008 <  109 ~ "de 0 a 109",
      # VDI5008 <  218 ~ "de 109 a 218",
      # VDI5008 <  353 ~ "de 218 a 353",
      # VDI5008 <  706 ~ "de 353 a 706",
      # TRUE ~ "Acima de 706",
       
      # VDI5008 <  218 ~ "de 0 a 218",
      # VDI5008 <  235 ~ "de 218 a 235",
      # VDI5008 <  250 ~ "de 235 a 250",
      # VDI5008 <  300 ~ "de 250 a 300",
      # VDI5008 <  500 ~ "de 300 a 500",
      # TRUE ~ "Acima de 500",
      # ),
    
      # VDI5008 <  218 ~ "de 0 a 218",
      # VDI5008 <  280 ~ "de 218 a 280",
      # VDI5008 <  392 ~ "de 280 a 392",
      # VDI5008 <  706 ~ "de 392 a 706",
      # TRUE ~ "Acima de 706",
      # ),
      
      VDI5008 <218~ "de 0 a 218",
      VDI5008 <333~ "de 218 a 333",
      VDI5008 <452~ "de 333 a 452",
      VDI5008 <564~ "de 452 a 564",
      VDI5008 <684~ "de 564 a 684",
      VDI5008 <750~ "de 684 a 750",
      TRUE ~ "Acima de 750",
      ),
    
    educ = dplyr::case_when(
      VD3004 == 1 ~ "sem instrucao ou fund. inc.", 
      VD3004 == 2 ~ "sem instrucao ou fund. inc.",
      VD3004 == 3 ~ "fund. completo", 
      VD3004 == 4 ~ "medio incompl.", 
      VD3004 == 5 ~ "medio completo", 
      VD3004 == 6 ~ "superior incompleto ou mais", 
      VD3004 == 7 ~ "superior incompleto ou mais"
    ),
    
    # Indicadores
    ebia_grave = dplyr::if_else(SD17001 == 4, 1L, 0L),
    atividade_agricola = dplyr::if_else(V40132A == 1, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    
    # Outras fontes (individual)
    outras_fontes = rowSums(
      dplyr::across(c(VI5001A2, VI5003A2, VI5004A2, VI5005A2, VI5006A2)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
    
  # =========================
  # AGREGAÇÃO DOMICILIAR
  # =========================
  dplyr::group_by(ID_DOMICILIO) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      flag_18 = as.integer(any(V2009 < 18, na.rm = TRUE)),
      flag_14 = as.integer(any(V2009 < 14, na.rm = TRUE)),
      renda_dom = sum(VD4019, na.rm = TRUE),
      outras_fontes_dom = sum(outras_fontes, na.rm = TRUE),
      pessoas = dplyr::n(),
      renda_pc = (renda_dom + outras_fontes_dom) / pessoas,
      agricultura_familiar = factor(any(V1022 == 2 & VD4007 %in% c(3,4), na.rm = TRUE))
      )|>
    dplyr::ungroup() |> 
    
  # =========================
  # VARIÁVEIS DE RENDA (NOVAS)
  # =========================
  dplyr::mutate(
    fl_perfil_caduni = dplyr::if_else(VDI5008 <= 706, 1L, 0L)
  ) 

# =========================
# FORMATAÇÃO FINAL
# =========================

data <- data |> dplyr::mutate(
  ebia_grave = factor(ebia_grave),
  V2007 = factor(V2007),
  V1022 = factor(V1022),
  flag_18 = factor(flag_18),
  flag_14 = factor(flag_14),
  atividade_agricola = factor(atividade_agricola),
  faixa_renda = faixa_renda,
  educ = factor(educ)
  ) |>
dplyr::filter(V2005 == "01") |> 
dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("S090000"))

```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
data_split <- rsample::initial_split(data, strata = ebia_grave)
train_data <- rsample::training(data_split)
test_data <- rsample::testing(data_split)
```

```{r}
rec <- recipes::recipe(
  as.formula(
    paste(
      "ebia_grave ~ ",
      "V2007 + raca + flag_18+ flag_14 + educ + faixa_renda + atividade_agricola + agricultura_familiar + V1022 + regiao_metro +",
      "UPA+ID_DOMICILIO+Estrato+V1027+V1028+V1029+V1033+posest+posest_sxi +",
      paste(sprintf("V1028%03d", seq(1:200)), collapse = "+")
      #, "+", paste(sprintf("V1036%03d", seq(1:200)), collapse = "+")
    )
  ),
  data = train_data
  ) |>
  themis::step_smotenc(ebia_grave, over_ratio = 1, seed = 42)

df_bal <- recipes::prep(rec) |>
  recipes::bake(new_data = NULL)

```

```{r}
dadosPnadC_dom <- PNADcIBGE::pnadc_design(df_bal)

dadosPnadC_dom$variables$educ <- relevel(
  dadosPnadC_dom$variables$educ, 
  ref = "sem instrucao ou fund. inc."
)

dadosPnadC_dom$variables$faixa_renda <- relevel(
  dadosPnadC_dom$variables$faixa_renda, 
  ref = "de 0 a 218"
)

dadosPnadC_dom$variables$regiao_metro <- relevel(
  dadosPnadC_dom$variables$regiao_metro, 
  ref = "RMF"
)

# fit16 <- survey::svyglm(
#   formula = ebia_grave~
#     V2007+
#     raca+
#     flag_18+
#     faixa_renda+
#     atividade_agricola+
#     V1022+
#     regiao_metro+
#     Estrato,
#   design = dadosPnadC_dom,
#   family = "binomial",
#   na.action = na.pass)

fit16 <- survey::svyglm(
  formula = ebia_grave~
    V2007+
    raca+
    flag_14+
    educ+
    faixa_renda+
    agricultura_familiar+
    V1022+
    regiao_metro+
    Estrato,
  design = dadosPnadC_dom,
  family = "binomial",
  na.action = na.pass)

summary(fit16)

mfx <- marginaleffects::avg_slopes(fit16)
print(mfx, topn = 30)

```


```{r}
dadosPnadC_dom$variables |>
  dplyr::count(faixa_renda, ebia_grave) |>
  dplyr::group_by(faixa_renda) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    perc = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = faixa_renda,
      y = perc,
      fill = factor(ebia_grave)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "%",
    fill = "EBIA grave"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()

dadosPnadC_dom$variables |>
  dplyr::count(faixa_renda, ebia_grave) |>
  dplyr::group_by(faixa_renda) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    perc = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

train_data |>
  dplyr::count(faixa_renda) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    perc = 100 * n / sum(n)
  )
```
